title: Safety database status: no ongoing access changes
summary: As of 13 November 2026, the available safety databases were checked and remain accessible. No confirmed source change is expected to reduce data freshness or search availability.
updates: **FDA MAUDE:** FDA continues its planned 2026 move of medical-device adverse-event data into the Adverse Event Monitoring System. The existing public MAUDE search route remains available; no change to searching is currently needed.
**TGA DAEN:** Planned maintenance on 8 November 2026 has passed. The database is responding normally in the latest check.
no_major_changes: FDA recalls and safety communications, BfArM, Swissmedic, MHRA, TGA DRAC, Health Canada incidents and recalls, PMDA, AEMPS, ANSM, and NMPA English showed no meaningful setup or access changes.
